newsitem.title: USA: Reliv U.S. network sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Reliv U.S. network sales rise.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said Thursday net sales from network marketing activities in the United States were up 32 percent for the first two months of the third quarter compared with a year ago.
A spokesman said U.S. network marketing sales through independent distributors exclude sales from international subsidiaries and revenues from contract packaging.

For all of the third quarter of 1995, U.S. sales totaled $5,378,704. Total net sales for the third quarter of 1995 were $6,841,365, based on sales at retail of $11,137,989, less distributor allowances of $4,296,624.
"The distributor confidence and momentum in the U.S. continues to grow and is producing higher sales numbers as a result," Robert Montgomery, chairman, said in a statement.
Reliv makes nutritional supplements, diet management products, sports drink mixes and skin care products.
